about.title: About
about.guide_notice_intro: The guide catalog stores reviewed names, links, and original OpenGameSave summaries. It does not redistribute linked articles or media.
about.overlab_license: External links only. Original articles are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; Blizzard-owned material remains Blizzard copyright.
about.liquipedia_license: External links only. Wiki text is CC BY-SA 3.0; media may use separate terms.
about.blizzard_license: Official pages are linked, not redistributed. Related names, images, and content remain the property of their respective owners.
about.game_art_notice: Artwork is read from trusted launcher caches first. Missing images may be fetched through size-limited, allowlisted official Steam, Epic, GOG, or Blizzard resources; artwork is not bundled and remains the property of its respective owners.
about.database_licenses: Database mappings are used under their MIT licenses; complete notices ship with the application.

main.title: OpenGameSave
main.library_empty_hint: Install a game with Steam, Epic, GOG, or Battle.net, then refresh the library.
main.guide_for_game_description: Open the exact technical wiki for this game, plus any official or community guides that passed manual review.
main.guide_database_description: Every matched game opens its exact PCGamingWiki page using the stable page ID in OpenGameSave's database. GitHub hosts PCGamingWiki's official redirect API; general game databases provide metadata, not reviewed walkthroughs.
main.overwatch_guide_title: A reliable starting point for every match
main.overwatch_guide_description: Official updates, Chinese mechanics references, hero data, and competitive records in one place.
main.auto_backup_mode_watcher: Back up when save files change
main.sync_description: Manage backup storage and sync backups with external services.
main.backup_path_sync_hint: This folder is the local source and download destination for cloud sync.
main.github_sync_download_hint: Pull Git backups into local storage
main.github_sync_note: Git must be installed and the storage path must be set to a clone of the target remote repository. Authentication credentials are handled entirely by the local Git configuration and are never accessed by OpenGameSave.
main.webdav_password_placeholder: Leave blank when no password is required
main.webdav_password_saved_placeholder: Saved; leave blank to keep unchanged
main.webdav_security_hint: HTTPS is required. The password is encrypted for this operating-system account and is never sent to the renderer; other processes running as the same user remain in the same trust boundary.
main.webdav_sync_upload_hint: Upload changes incrementally while preserving remote-only backups
main.webdav_sync_download_hint: Verify and merge remote backups into local storage
main.webdav_sync_note: HTTPS is required. When authentication is used, prefer an app-specific password. Uploads publish immutable snapshots with concurrency checks and preserve conflicting backups.
